item.title: Reuse existing money helpers for Decimal math
item.description: When implementing monetary calculations, use the project's existing to_money/round_money/ZERO helpers rather than raw arithmetic.
item.content: Inspect money.py first to find conversion and rounding utilities. Wrap raw values with to_money before multiplying, seed sums with ZERO, and apply round_money to the final result so finance rounding policy is honored.

item.title: Guard division with a zero-total check
item.description: For weighted-average or ratio computations, check the denominator before dividing and return the domain's zero value.
item.content: Compute total_quantity first; if it is falsy (no lines or zero quantity), return ZERO instead of dividing. This satisfies the 'no lines means zero' spec and avoids ZeroDivisionError.

item.title: Read the target file and tests before editing
item.description: Before implementing a new function, cat the module, related helpers, models, and any existing tests to match conventions.
item.content: The agent inspected invoice.py, money.py, models.py, and the test file before writing code, which revealed the Decimal-based style and rounding helpers. This upfront reconnaissance led to a first-attempt acceptance.
